correctness.rationale: For integer m>=3 the cubic Möbius ladder has 2m vertices with cycle plus antipodal edges. In the cyclic length-m sequence of antipodal column types A (both selected), Z (neither), P/Q (one selected), the twist exchanges P/Q at seam. Feasibility forces adjacent mixed columns to transport a common selected row and forbids an all-mixed closed twisted strip. Empty runs have length <=2, each adjacent A-run length >=2; with both empty and mixed a count of at least r+1 A-runs gives a-z>=2 and |D|>=m+2. With mixed/no empty, equality m+1 forces one full column, giving exactly 2m length-(m+1) intervals. Without mixed, A/Z columns are precisely a total-dominating cyclic binary word (A-runs >=2, Z-runs <=2). This yields m with 4 rotations of 1100 when m divisible by 4, m+2 lower if m=2 mod4, and for odd m precisely m unique-defect total-dominating column words with a-z=1. Thus gamma=m or m+1 and N_m=4, 2m or 3m as claimed. Independently exhaustively enumerated all labelled subsets of M_2m for m=3..9; minima and numbers match all congruence classes, beyond-edge cases m=3,4. Infinite assertion rests on run inequalities, not finite tests.
